title: Transparent prior-art overlap assessor for research ideas using retrieved evidence and claim-aware signals
abstract: We build a local system that accepts a research idea, retrieves relevant literature, analyses claim-aware overlap, distinguishes direct overlap from adjacent similarity, and returns a transparent prior-art risk report grounded in admissible evidence.
claims: accept a research idea and retrieve relevant literature
distinguish direct overlap from adjacent similarity
return a transparent prior-art risk report
